description: TE Connectivity plc is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive and connected future, and as a trusted innovation partner its broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. During fiscal 2024 its board of directors and shareholders approved a change in its jurisdiction of incorporation from Switzerland to Ireland, completed on September 30, 2024, and effective for fiscal 2025 it is organized under the laws of Ireland, and it has not had and does not anticipate any material changes in its operations or financing.
